detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

I built a Terraform/OpenTofu module that spins up a Zabbix Proxy on an immutable Fedora CoreOS VM in Proxmox. It generates TLS certs, transpiles Butane to Ignition, and runs Zabbix Proxy + Agent2 as Podman Quadlet containers with auto-updates and a customisable patching window.

Check it out: https://codefloe.com/cichy1173/cichyform/src/branch/main/Proxmox/zabbix-proxy-fcos

#Zabbix #FedoraCoreOS #Terraform #Podman #DevOps
